resources.string: Slivue reads app names, senders, notification titles and message text, timestamps and reply actions, including while this screen is closed. Notifications can contain private or sensitive information.

This access is used to display and filter notifications in the edge panel and send replies you choose to write. Quick replies go to the original messaging app, which handles delivery. The optional pause-video setting also accesses active media sessions.

The Play build processes notifications on your device. It has no Internet permission, advertising or analytics SDK, cloud backup, downloaded font provider or APK self-updater. Imported fonts and settings stay in app storage.

The GitHub build processes notifications on your device. Quick replies are passed to the original app; selected fonts and update checks can use the Internet. Settings may be restored by Android backup. Diagnostic output is optional and may contain private text.

You can choose Later without granting access. Stop Slivue pauses notification processing, clears its in-memory history and removes the overlays. Withdraw consent also stops processing; you can separately revoke Android notification access in system settings.
